name: Pinned
description: Pin files to the sidebar as pages, in your order: drag to reorder, drag a file from the tree to pin it, or Pin in a file's menu. The pinned pages are also in search, in its settings, in the phone's drawer and as tiles on a phone's new tab, and a new device opens on the first one. Off, nothing is pinned or shown; your list stays in .vaultite/pages.json.

show.label: Show pinned pages as
show.description: in the open sidebar: a list of their names, or a grid of their icons, each named when pointed at
